cohort.definition: ARCHETYPE RECORD — NOT A COMPANY. This file describes a typical AI infrastructure startup's entry-level hiring pattern, synthesized as an archetype for planning when no company-specific record exists. It must never be quoted as facts about any individual company.
cohort.time_window: listings and program pages live when checked, October 2026

data_sources.label: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Occupational Outlook Handbook (computer and information technology occupations) — public occupational context for the archetype's roles
Archetype synthesis note: patterns stated qualitatively from the archetype definition; no company source exists by design

entries.label: No school pattern published
entries.note: Archetype records publish no school pattern: startups of this type hire across school tiers and screen on shipped work; no distribution is claimed.

entries.label: Prior internship or shipped project evidence
entries.note: The archetype's stated expectation pattern — evidence of built work, not a measured employer mix.

entries.label: Computer science or a related field, or equivalent shipped evidence
entries.note: The archetype's degree frame — many such startups accept equivalent project evidence; stated as a pattern, not a measured mix.

entries.label: ML systems: Python, distributed systems, GPU / serving infrastructure
entries.note: The skill cluster this archetype's entry postings characteristically name — a pattern statement, not a measured mix.

path_patterns.pattern: Intern or research-engineering role converting on systems depth
Open-source ML tooling route: contributions to widely used ML infrastructure as the application

entry_routes.accessibility_note: Screen centers depth: distributed systems, performance reasoning and strong Python or systems languages.
Merged work in ML tooling repositories is this archetype's most legible evidence.

hiring_bar_summary.statement: Archetype bar: the deepest technical screen of the startup archetypes — systems fundamentals, performance reasoning and evidence of building at scale, because the product is infrastructure other engineers depend on.

stated.statement: Stated pattern: Python plus a systems language, distributed-systems coursework or projects, and ML framework familiarity.

revealed.statement: Revealed pattern: benchmark and performance literacy — candidates who measure and reason about latency, throughput and cost read as native.

process_stages.stage: Application or warm introduction against a live posting
process_stages.description: Archetype pattern: a short process run by the hiring team itself; the live posting and a direct conversation are the sources of truth for any specific company.

interview_styles.statement: Archetype pattern: deep technical conversations over prior systems work, often with the founding engineers; exercises probe real performance trade-offs rather than puzzle speed.

values_culture_signals.statement: Archetype pattern: research-adjacent engineering culture: papers, benchmarks and open-source presence are the stated currency.

hiring_cadence.statement: Archetype pattern: hiring tracks model and funding cycles and can open at any month; small cohorts, filled as found. No annual cycle is claimed.

compensation_notes.statement: Archetype pattern: compensation is set company by company and stated, when stated, on the individual posting. This record quotes no figure: any specific company's posting is the only authoritative source.

referral_weight_notes.statement: Archetype pattern: warm introductions and community presence (open source, meetups, prior collaborators) characteristically carry more weight at small startups than at large firms, because screens are run by small teams. This is a pattern statement about the archetype, not a claim about any company.

red_flags.statement: Archetype risk: the bar is genuinely research-lab deep at the top of this archetype — a mismatch wastes both sides' cycle; self-assess against the stated systems depth honestly.
Archetype risk: infrastructure intern projects can be swallowed by production firefighting; confirm a scoped project with an owner.

thesis_text: This record describes an archetype, not a company: the typical AI-infrastructure startup hiring students into ML systems work. Its screen is depth — distributed systems, performance measurement and open-source evidence a founding engineer can inspect. Routes in run through the tooling itself. Every pattern here is qualitative, carries no sample, and must be re-verified against a specific company's own posting before it is used for a decision.
known_biases_of_data: THIS IS AN ARCHETYPE, NOT A COMPANY: every statement describes a typical pattern for planning and must be re-verified against any specific company's own postings before acting.
No population sample exists for this record and none is claimed; all distributions are curated-qualitative with null sample size.
Archetype patterns age quickly as a sector's funding and hiring climate shifts; treat the as_of date as a hard freshness bound.
schema_normalized: Envelope mapped to the 125-career-intel validator schema by scripts/career/normalize-cir.py. No facts added, removed, or altered.
